## Our purpose

The Association connects Port Credit High School and Port Credit Secondary School alumni with one another, with the school’s history and with opportunities to support current students.

## What we do

- organize Alumni Night and other community gatherings;
- share alumni news and memories;
- recognize students through alumni-supported scholarships;
- connect alumni with mentoring, speaking and volunteer opportunities;
- maintain yearbooks, photographs and school history for the community.

## Join the community

The alumni form is the easiest way to receive updates and tell us how you would like to participate.

[Fill out the alumni form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeaQ4rv75jUmWQH8Xmxpcpyyi7e6K1_elXwRO4YjX0MxNp7QA/viewform){.button .button-primary}

## Independent alumni organization

The PCSS Alumni Association is alumni-led and is not affiliated with Port Credit Secondary School or the Peel District School Board.
